01 / The practice

Attention is a design tool.

Most projects start with a slow walk, a conversation, or a detail that asks to be noticed. I use those encounters to make work that gives people a clearer way into a place, a species or an idea.

I care about the part after something looks finished: whether it feels generous to use, whether it carries its context well, and whether it makes people want to return.

02 / How I work

01

Start in the field

Observe first. Let a landscape, a community or a species set the terms for the work.

02

Make it legible

Translate complex knowledge into an invitation that people can feel and use.

03

Leave room for return

Build identities, tools and experiences that grow with the people who care for them.
